parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use product rule on a correct expression. Condone with $+x/(8-x)$ unless there is clear evidence of incorrect product rule. [M1]
Obtain correct derivative in any form, e.g. $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=\ln(8-x)-\dfrac{x}{8-x}$. [A1]
Equate derivative to 1 and obtain $x=8-\dfrac8{\ln(8-x)}$. Given answer: check carefully that it follows from correct working. Condone use of $a$ for $x$ throughout. [A1] Total 3.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Calculate values of a relevant expression or pair of relevant expressions at $x=2.9$ and $x=3.1$, e.g. $8-8/\ln5.1=3.09>2.9$ and $8-8/\ln4.9=2.97<3.1$. Clear linking of pairs is needed by this method; corresponding differences are 0.19 and -0.13. [M1]
Complete the argument correctly with correct calculated values. It is also valid to consider the gradient at 2.9 (1.06…) and 3.1 (0.95…) and compare with 1. [A1] Total 2.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use $x_{n+1}=8-\dfrac8{\ln(8-x_n)}$ correctly to find at least two successive values. Examples printed in the guidance: from 3, 3.0293, 3.0111, 3.0225, 3.0154, (3.0198); from 2.9, 3.0897, 2.9728, 3.0460, 3.0006, 3.290, 3.0113, 3.0223, 3.0155 (the official MS prints “3.290”); from 3.1, 2.9661, 3.0501, 2.9980, 3.0305, 3.0103, 3.0229, 3.0151. SR: clear successive use of 0, 1, 2, 3 etc., or equivalent, scores M0. Allow M1 if values are given to fewer than 4 d.p. [M1]
Obtain final answer 3.02. [A1]
Show sufficient iterations to at least 4 d.p. to justify 3.02 to 2 d.p., or show a sign change in (3.015, 3.025). Must have two consecutive values rounding correctly to 3.02. [A1] Total 3.
